subtitle.en: Dear Customer, The Return and Refund policy of Lappy Valley are given below –

body.en: We deliver within 5 days inside Dhaka and 10 days outside Dhaka
body.bn: আমরা ঢাকার ভিতরে ৫ দিনের মধ্যে এবং ঢাকার বাইরে ১০ দিনের মধ্যে ডেলিভারি করি

body.en: If a customer is buying the products from our shops, then please make sure to check the products in front of our Sales Executive. Later, if any problems occurs than the customer will not be entitled to any changes but will be given services based on the products provided description.(Warranty)
body.bn: আউট লেট থেকে পণ্য ক্রয়ের ক্ষেত্রে অবশ্যই শপে বিক্রয়কর্মীর সামনে চেক করে কিনবেন। পরবর্তীতে সমস্যা হলে যদি পণ্যে ওয়ারেন্টি থাকে তবে তা ওয়ারেন্টির আওতাভুক্ত হবে।

body.en: In the case of ordering online, after receiving the product, if any manufacturing issues or problems are noticed or discovered than customer has to inform us within 24 hours via our hotline service.
body.bn: অনলাইন অর্ডারের ক্ষেত্রে পণ্য ডেলিভারি পাবার পর পণ্যে মেনুফেকচারিং ত্রুটি থাকলে আমাদের হটলাইনে ২৪ ঘন্টার মধ্যে জানাতে হবে।

body.en: If a customer received a manufacturing defected product than the customer has to visit any of our shops where our specialists will review the product first and then take the necessary steps to changing the product if it is in need of replacement.
body.bn: ত্রুটিযুক্ত পণ্য আমাদের স্টোর থেকে পরিবর্তন করা যাবে। এক্ষেত্রে আমাদের এক্সপার্টগন পণ্যে ত্রুটি পর্যবেক্ষণ করে তা পরিবর্তন করার পদক্ষেপ গ্রহন করবেন।

body.en: If a customer wants to change the defected product through our delivery service, then a charge Of TK. 200/- has to be paid as replacement charge inside Dhaka and if out of Dhaka, only the Courier charge is applicable.
body.bn: ক্রেতা যদি ডেলিভারি ম্যান এর মাধ্যমে ত্রুটিযুক্ত পণ্য পরিবর্তন করতে ইচ্ছুক থাকেন অথবা পণ্য পরিবর্তন করতে চান তবে ৩০০/- টাকা পরিবর্তন চার্জ প্রযোজ্য হবে। ঢাকার বাইরের ক্ষেত্রে শুধুমাত্র কুরিয়ার চার্জ প্রযোজ্য হবে। পণ্য আনার পর যদি পণ্য ভাঙ্গা অথবা পোড়া/ জ্বলা অবস্থায় পাওয়া যায় তবে সেই পণ্যের সম্পূর্ণ দায়িক্ত ক্রেতাকে বহন করতে হবে।

title.en: No returns for change of mind

body.en: If a Customer is buying any product from our Website after reading the description and provided information’s about the particular product and is received successfully without any faults and later if the product is not compatible with your setup or if you do not want it anymore, then you will not be allowed to change or return the product.
body.bn: ল্যাপী ভ্যালি এর ওয়েবসাইটে থাকা বিবরণী দেখে ক্রয়ক্রিত পণ্য ডেলিভারি কর্মী থেকে রিসিভ করার পর তা আপনার নির্দিষ্ট ডিভাইসে সাপোর্ট করছে না অথবা তা এখন আর কিনতে ইচ্ছুক নন, এই জাতিয় কোন কারনে পণ্য ফেরত অথবা পরিবর্তন বা গ্রহনযোগ্য নয়।

body.en: If customers found broken or packet damaged product then we are requesting not to receive the product from courier service. If the customer receives courier damaged product then he/she have to take his/her own liability and any kind of complaint won’t be acceptable.
body.bn: কুরিয়ার এর ক্ষেত্রে ক্রেতা অবশ্যই পণ্য ভাঙ্গা থাকলে অথবা প্যাকেট ছেঁড়া থাকলে কুরিয়ার থেকে পণ্য রিসিভ করবে না। কুরিয়ারে ক্ষতিগ্রস্ত পণ্য ক্রেতা রিসিভ করলে তা নিজ দায়িত্বে করতে হবে এবং এই ব্যাপারে পরে কোন অভিযোগ গ্রহণযোগ্য হবে না।

body.en: With specific reasoning’s, product(s) will be allowed to be returned and refunded back to you within 3 to 10 working days and in the case of online purchase, the procedure may take longer to execute.
body.bn: নির্দিষ্ট কারণে পণ্য রিটার্ন দেয়ার পর তার মূল্য রিফান্ড করতে ৩ থেকে ১০ কার্যদিবস বা অনলাইন পেমেন্টের ক্ষেত্রে আরও বেশি সময় লাগতে পারে।

body.en: Refund charge applicable for Bkash / Online / POS payment refund.

To start a return, you can contact us at {email}. If your return is accepted, we’ll send you a return shipping label, as well as instructions on how and where to send your package. Items sent back to us without first requesting a return will not be accepted.

body.en: Our website address is: [https://lappyvalley.com](https://lappyvalley.com).

title.en: What personal data we collect and why we collect it

body.en:
### Comments

When visitors leave comments on the site we collect the data shown in the comments form, and also the visitor’s IP address and browser user agent string to help spam detection.

An anonymized string created from your email address (also called a hash) may be provided to the Gravatar service to see if you are using it. The Gravatar service privacy policy is available here: [https://automattic.com/privacy/](https://automattic.com/privacy/). After approval of your comment, your profile picture is visible to the public in the context of your comment.

### Media

If you upload images to the website, you should avoid uploading images with embedded location data (EXIF GPS) included. Visitors to the website can download and extract any location data from images on the website.

### Contact forms

_[Add details here]_

### Embedded content from other websites

Articles on this site may include embedded content (e.g. videos, images, articles, etc.). Embedded content from other websites behaves in the exact same way as if the visitor has visited the other website.

These websites may collect data about you, use cookies, embed additional third-party tracking, and monitor your interaction with that embedded content, including tracking your interaction with the embedded content if you have an account and are logged in to that website.

### Analytics

_[Add details here]_

If you leave a comment on our site you may opt-in to saving your name, email address and website in cookies. These are for your convenience so that you do not have to fill in your details again when you leave another comment. These cookies will last for one year.

If you visit our login page, we will set a temporary cookie to determine if your browser accepts cookies. This cookie contains no personal data and is discarded when you close your browser.

When you log in, we will also set up several cookies to save your login information and your screen display choices. Login cookies last for two days, and screen options cookies last for a year. If you select “Remember Me”, your login will persist for two weeks. If you log out of your account, the login cookies will be removed.

If you edit or publish an article, an additional cookie will be saved in your browser. This cookie includes no personal data and simply indicates the post ID of the article you just edited. It expires after 1 day.

title.en: Who we share your data with and How long we retain your data

body.en:
If you leave a comment, the comment and its metadata are retained indefinitely. This is so we can recognize and approve any follow-up comments automatically instead of holding them in a moderation queue.

For users that register on our website (if any), we also store the personal information they provide in their user profile. All users can see, edit, or delete their personal information at any time (except they cannot change their username). Website administrators can also see and edit that information.

title.en: What rights you have over your data

body.en: If you have an account on this site, or have left comments, you can request to receive an exported file of the personal data we hold about you, including any data you have provided to us. You can also request that we erase any personal data we hold about you. This does not include any data we are obliged to keep for administrative, legal, or security purposes.
Visitor comments may be checked through an automated spam detection service.
Email {email} or call {hotline}. You can also visit any of our three outlets — Uttara, Jamuna Future Park or Bashundhara City.

subtitle.en: The short version first — tap any section below for the full details.

label.en: Working days to process your refund
Check your laptop before the courier leaves

body.en: We provide complimentary lifetime service for all laptops.

Once your return is received and inspected, we will email you to confirm that we have received your returned item. We will also tell you whether your refund is approved or rejected.

If it is approved, your refund will be processed and a credit will automatically be applied to your credit card or original method of payment.

We refund within 7 to 10 working days. The process may take longer because of technical issues.

1. First, check your bank account again.
1. Then contact your credit card company — it may take some time before your refund is officially posted.
1. Next, contact your bank. There is often some processing time before a refund is posted.
1. If you have done all of this and still have not received your refund, contact us at {email}.

We only replace items that are defective or damaged at the time of delivery. Check the product properly in front of the delivery person — once they leave, the product is no longer eligible for return.

If the item was marked as a gift when purchased and shipped directly to you, you will receive a gift credit for the value of your return. Once the returned item is received, a gift certificate will be mailed to you.

If the item was not marked as a gift when purchased, or the gift giver had the order shipped to themselves to give to you later, we will send the refund to the gift giver and they will find out about your return.
Only torn, faulty or wrong products are refundable. Other products cannot be returned.
Contact us at {email} for questions about refunds and returns, or call {hotline}.

content.heading: Questions?
content.subheading: Everything about buying, paying for and getting your laptop from Lappy Valley.

items.question: Do you sell brand new or used laptops?
items.answer: Both. We sell brand new laptops and pre-owned laptops graded AAA+, imported from the USA, Dubai and Japan.

items.question: Which brands do you carry?
items.answer: MacBook, HP, ASUS, Dell, Lenovo, MSI, Acer, Microsoft Surface, Toshiba, Razer Blade and Samsung, in many different models.

items.question: Which payment methods do you accept?
items.answer: Cash on delivery, or online payment by Visa, Mastercard, bKash, Nagad, Upay, TakaPay and more. Online payments are verified by SSLCommerz.

items.question: Can I use a coupon code?
items.answer: Yes. Open your cart, tap “Add a coupon code?”, enter the code and apply it before you confirm the order.

items.question: How do I track my order?
items.answer: Log in and open My Account → Orders. Each order shows its status (Pending, Processing, Delivered) and payment status.

items.question: How much does delivery cost?
items.answer: Store pickup is free. Express delivery costs ৳120 and is delivered through SA P.B.

items.question: Can I see the laptop before buying?
items.answer: Yes. Visit any of our three outlets — Uttara (Rajuk Commercial Complex), Jamuna Future Park or Bashundhara City.

items.question: Do your laptops come with a warranty?
items.answer: Warranty depends on the laptop. Check the Warranty section on each product page.

items.question: What if I have a problem after buying?
items.answer: We provide after-sales service. Bring the laptop to any outlet or call {hotline} and we will solve it.

productReviews.name: Test User
productReviews.subject: Excellent Laptop with Smooth Performance
productReviews.comment: The laptop works perfectly and delivers excellent performance. It handles multitasking smoothly, boots quickly, and has a great display. The build quality is also impressive. Overall, I'm very satisfied with this purchase.

productReviews.name: Test User
productReviews.subject: Great Value for the Price
productReviews.comment: I'm really happy with this laptop. It offers good performance for its price, has a decent battery life, and looks stylish. Perfect for everyday work, browsing, and entertainment.

productReviews.name: Test User
productReviews.subject: Perfect Laptop for Students
productReviews.comment: This laptop is a great choice for students. It's lightweight, easy to carry, and handles daily tasks like assignments, browsing, and online classes without any issues. Highly recommended.

productReviews.name: Test User
productReviews.subject: Beautiful Design and Clear Display
productReviews.comment: The laptop has a sleek design and a beautiful display. The keyboard is comfortable to use, and everything feels well-built. It's a great option for both work and personal use.

productReviews.name: Test User
productReviews.subject: Good Laptop but Could Be Better
productReviews.comment: The overall experience is good. Performance is acceptable for regular tasks, and the design is nice. However, the battery life could be better. Still, it's a decent laptop for everyday use.
